outcome_cover.method: clang -fsanitize-coverage=trace-pc-guard edges (each branch outcome) over every linked source but the test harness, per case (tools/irc_edges.c)

boundary: from each routine entry state to NEWOPS with LOC outside the file, an exit of the interpreter bodies (lm: POODOO1, ALARM1; cm: POODOO, ALARM), or a transfer to an outside basic routine (lm: ALARM, BANKCALL, CHANG2, CURTAINS, DOWNFLAG, ENDOFJOB, FINDVAC, GOTOPOOH, IBNKCALL, MAKECADR, PHASCHNG, SWCALL, SWRETURN, TASKOVER, TWIDDLE, UPFLAG; cm: ALARM, BANKCALL, BLANKET, CHANG2, CHECKMM, CLEARMRK, CURTAINS, DOWNFLAG, ENDOFJOB, FALTON, FINDVAC, GOTOPOOH, MAKECADR, PHASCHNG, SWCALL, UPFLAG)
compared: Z, 2048 erasable words (A, L 16-bit) and the interrupt-enable state
